reviews.text:
Amina Masjid is truly a beautiful and peaceful place of worship. The atmosphere is calm and welcoming, making it perfect for prayer, reflection, and connecting with the community. The masjid is well-maintained, clean, and organized, which adds to the overall spiritual experience.

The management and volunteers are very kind, respectful, and always ready to help. The imam delivers meaningful and inspiring khutbahs that are easy to understand and relevant to everyday life. It’s also great to see how the masjid brings people together through community events and programs.

Whether you’re coming for daily prayers or special occasions, Amina Masjid provides a warm and uplifting environment. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a peaceful and spiritually enriching place.

reviews.text: I've been to many masajids across the United States but nothing compares to the spirituality, the unity and the sanctity that this masjid brings. It is truly the beginning of an unprecedented era in the history of the Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jamāt in the United States of America. From the leaders, the well educated and spiritually gifted scholars, to the tightly knitted community members and the local attendees, you will never be able to find it elsewhere. This is truly a blessing by the grace of Allah Subhanuhu wa Ta'ala. May Allah preserve this masjid, allow it to blossom into something even more special than it already is. Ameen.

reviews.name: Summer Ala
reviews.text:
My husband and I were driving back to Maryland from Philadelphia and realized we were going to miss Maghrib prayer. We searched for a nearby mosque and found this one.

From the moment we arrived, we felt incredibly welcomed. There were four gentlemen there who greeted us warmly and even offered us tea. Everyone was kind, friendly, and genuinely hospitable. I believe one of them was the imam, and he was especially welcoming.

It’s rare to walk into a place and immediately feel at home, but that’s exactly how we felt here. We are very grateful for their kindness and generosity.

I highly recommend this mosque to anyone passing through or looking for a welcoming community. May Allah reward them all for their hospitality.
